messages:
zee: quick design sync on API Key management UI. goals: make rows denser, improve discoverability of copy/reveal, and add clear a11y text. sketch: https://figma.com/file/alpha (variant A/B)
rob: nice. two immediate recs: 1) show a compact scope summary '3 scopes 3 more' to avoid multi-line rows, 2) keep a persistent 'Copy' ghost button left so users don't rely on reveal.
sam: agree. implementation detail: chips can be decorative (aria-hidden=true) and a single offscreen string 'Scopes: read, write, deploy' is provided for screen readers.
nora: accessibility: reveal must announce via aria-live polite and require a short confirmation if session auth > 15m. aria-label for reveal -> 'Reveal API key. Visible for 30 seconds.'
dina: copy tweak for create modal: change "This key will be shown once" -> "This key will be revealed only once. Save it securely now; you will not be able to view it again." (explicit)
zee: post-create behavior: don't rely on toast. show a one-time inline preview card in the list with expiry pill (e.g., 'expires in 45m') and progress indicator. allow 'pin reminder' affordance.
rob: revoke flow: add optional reason + note. quick radio reasons: rotated, compromised, no-longer-used, other (optional). show small privacy hint: 'Notes visible to org admins'.
sam: backend: will add revoke_reason and revoke_note to audit model. front-end will POST /api/keys/:id/revoke with { reason, note } behind feature flag keys_audit_notes.
nora: when revocation happens, announce polite live region: 'API key "{name}" revoked by {user}. Reason: {reason}.' ensure no secrets in announcements.
dina: mobile: actions collapse into kebab, but Copy stays visible. ensure touch targets >=44px and avoid swipe-delete gestures for keys.
zee: A/B test request: variant 1 = chips + overflow counter; variant 2 = single-line compressed summary + dialog. track clicks on 'show scopes' and time-to-copy.
rob: design detail: use subtle amber for inline least-privilege hint with :information_source: tooltip linking to docs. don't overload modal footers.
sam: keyboard nav: recommend row-level single tab stop (row container). arrow keys move focus between actionable cells. doc both tab and arrow modes in the component spec.
nora: a11y nit: when key is revealed, if a screen reader is detected ask for explicit confirmation: 'Reveal to screen reader? confirm to proceed' to avoid accidental broadcast.
dina: small microcopy: when revealed show 'Visible for 30s  copy now' and change copy button to 'Copied!' for 2s and announce via aria-live.
deploy-bot: reminder: feature-flag keys_ui_relaunch scheduled for staging 2026-04-12. include accessibility sign-off in checklist.
zee: action items: 1) rob to add both variants to figma + annotate states, 2) sam to draft aria attributes and keyboard interaction examples, 3) nora to write confirm wording and live-region strings, 4) dina to add backend audit fields behind flag. I'll file acceptance criteria and link the ticket after this thread. :thumbsup:
